snippet.title: Celia's Stupid Romhack - Trailer (Demo Available!)
snippet.description:
READ DESCRIPTION FOR THE DOWNLOAD LINK!

Hi, Friends!
Welcome to Celia's Stupid Romhack!

Enjoy a cavalcade of hilarity, nonsense, and fun! Grab some friends and sit around and enjoy the show together!

Every line of dialogue is quirky and fun, and every Pokemon has been changed in some way. I strongly recommend completing the Pokedex while you play!

Official Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/wFmHfgz3JA

Download Link:
https://www.hackdex.app/hack/celias-stupid-romhack

Thanks so much to MasterFoF for editing this trailer for me!
You're the best, my dude!
